## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and the motivation for this change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm audit --omit=dev`
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, tokens, payment signatures, databases, or user data included

## Risk and rollout

Describe payment, proxy, schema, security, compatibility, or operational risk and the rollback plan. State explicitly when the change is documentation-only.
